title: Helicopter Landing Area Selection

nodes.text: Is the area reasonably flat and clear of obstructions?

evidence.source_text: Locate a reasonably flat area clear of people, vehicles, and obstructions such as trees, poles, and overhead wires.

nodes.text: Ensure area is free of stumps, brush, posts, large rocks, and anything over 18 inches high

evidence.source_text: The area must be free of stumps, brush, posts, large rocks, and anything over 18 inches high.
Consider the wind direction. Helicopters land and take off into the wind.

nodes.text: Choose an approach free of obstructions

evidence.source_text: Choose an approach free of obstructions.

nodes.text: Relay any obstruction to the helicopter crew on initial radio contact

evidence.source_text: Any obstruction should be relayed to the helicopter crew on initial radio contact.

nodes.text: Remove or secure any loose items in and around the landing area

evidence.source_text: Remove or secure any loose items in and around the landing area such as trash, blankets, hats, or equipment.

nodes.text: Wet down the landing area if dusty conditions are present

evidence.source_text: Wet down the landing area if dusty conditions are present.

nodes.text: Address LCES prior to staffing existing or proposed helicopter landing areas

evidence.source_text: Address LCES prior to staffing existing or proposed helicopter landing areas.

nodes.text: Type 1 Helicopters: Safety circle 110', Touchdown pad 30' x 30', clear and level

evidence.source_text: Type 1 Helicopters - Safety circle: 110 - Touchdown pad: 30 x 30, clear and level

nodes.text: Type 2 Helicopters: Safety circle 90', Touchdown pad 20' x 20', clear and level

nodes.text: Ensure items needed are available: 40 BC fire extinguisher, wind indicator, compatible radio, pad marker, allowable payloads, manifest book, dust abatement

evidence.source_text: Items Needed  40 BC fire extinguisher (20 lb.)  Wind indicator  Radio (compatible with helicopter)  Pad marker  Allowable payloads (HIGE and HOGE) for all helicopters using helispot  Passenger/cargo manifest book  Dust abatement, as needed
